edits.content: For restaurant ratings and hotel guest ratings, interpret an unqualified numeric score (for example, “3.5 rating”) as exact and use `[N, N]` in `rating`. Use `[N, 5]` only when the user states a minimum, such as “at least N” or “N or higher.” For hotel star classification, use `stars`, not guest `rating`: use `[N, N]` for an exact star class and `[N, 5]` for “at least N stars.”
